description: Angular component for managing and displaying a list of entity subtypes with autocomplete and chip input features, supporting various entity types and dynamic data fetching.

classes.name: EntitySubTypeListComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for selecting entity subtypes with autocomplete and chips.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates form validators based on the 'required' input.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets placeholders, subscribes to broadcast events, and sets up filtered entity subtype observable.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form group.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's value and updates form controls.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new subtype to the list and propagates change.

methods.name: chipAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a subtype via chip input.

methods.name: addOnBlur
methods.description: Adds subtype on input blur if related target exists.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a subtype from the list and propagates change.

methods.name: displayEntitySubtypeFn
methods.description: Returns display string for a subtype.

methods.name: fetchEntitySubtypes
methods.description: Fetches filtered list of subtypes based on search text.

methods.name: getEntitySubtypes
methods.description: Retrieves entity subtypes from various services based on entity type.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates validation if dirty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears input and refocuses input element.

methods.name: customTranslate
methods.description: Returns custom translation for an entity string.
